response.understanding_of_requirement:
UNDERSTANDING OF REQUIREMENT

NSWC IHD faces the challenge of processing security clearance fingerprints for personnel nationwide.

Solicitation N0017426Q1009 requires electronic fingerprint capture using Live Scan equipment at existing contractor locations.

The contractor must maintain active SWFT certification through DCSA.

We share NSWC IHD's commitment to security and understand the critical nature of this requirement.

Our analysis shows three key elements drive success.

First, nationwide geographic coverage with convenient locations for personnel.

Second, compliance with OPM standards and SWFT transmission requirements as prescribed by federal regulations.

Third, web-based scheduling system for tracking submissions pursuant to DCSA guidelines.

The contractor must process up to 900 personnel per year while maintaining rejection rates below 2%.

We agree this benchmark ensures mission continuity for NSWC IHD.
